text: まずは　１のしまに　いって　あのへんを　さがそうかなー　じゃ　おさき！

structure.jp: あのへんを　さがそうかなー
structure.en: I wonder if I'll search around there

patterns.name: 〜(よ)うかな
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form plus かな means you are thinking aloud about doing something. さがそうかなー = 'I think I'll search'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: て joins actions in order. いって　さがす = 'go, and then search'.
